t: Rename hub Signals folder to lowercase and add signal processing/routing on each gardener run
challenge: Hub WAI-Hub/Signals/ uses non-standard capital S. 62 signals in incoming/ accrue indefinitely with no processing. Framework-targeted signals should be held until framework absorbs them, hub-targeted signals should route to Hub KB.
perceive: 1. Confirm hub/WAI-Hub/Signals/ exists with capital S (62 incoming, 255 processed, 21 by-target). 2. Confirm hub/WAI-Hub/signals/ (lowercase) does NOT exist. 3. Grep all references to 'WAI-Hub/Signals' across framework/templates/commands/, framework/.claude/, hub/.claude/agents/ (7+ files found). 4. Read each incoming signal's target field to understand routing distribution.
execute: 1. git mv hub/WAI-Hub/Signals hub/WAI-Hub/signals (preserves git history). 2. Update all references in 7 files: wai.md, wai-closeout.md, wai-lug-schema.md, .claude/commands/wai.md, ozi-gardener.md, and any others found by grep. 3. Add signal triage instructions to gardener agent: on each run, process incoming/ by target field — framework→hold in by-target/framework/, hub→route to Hub KB, spokes→already handled by teaching distribution. Move processed signals from incoming/ to processed/. 4. No signal should sit in incoming/ longer than one gardener run.
verify: 1. find hub/WAI-Hub/Signals 2>/dev/null returns nothing (capital S gone). 2. ls hub/WAI-Hub/signals/incoming/ confirms lowercase path works. 3. grep -r 'WAI-Hub/Signals' framework/ hub/ returns zero matches. 4. Gardener agent definition includes signal triage instructions.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Rename hub signals folder to lowercase and add signal processing so signals don't accrue indefinitely
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not changing signal content or schema — only folder naming and adding routing/processing on gardener runs
